projectState.summary: Byte 10d is implemented and ready for Claude review. Performed offsets now schedule Tone one-shots at shifted transport ticks while `MusicalEvent.absoluteBeat` remains grid truth. Synth fire times clamp late callbacks to `now + epsilon`; events also carry `performedOffsetSeconds` and `timing:audible-offset`. The performed-time model now includes leap, register, and local-density difficulty weighted by disposition, and smoke adds a restart replay assertion for deterministic offsets.
